description: Algorithmic decision tree and autonomous solver pipeline for resolving Plain Damage omens and surviving incoming plain damage attacks in Battle System 2.0.

solverPipeline.name: Omen Requirement Interception
solverPipeline.logic: Extract required plain damage amount (D_req) and hit count from active omen condition (e.g. 2,000,000 in Lucilius Labor 7, or 777,777 in specialized trials).

solverPipeline.name: Yamato Pre-Execution Bypass / Reduction
solverPipeline.logic: If Main Character class is Yamato: evaluate Seasplitter (instant cancel if Yashiori stacks == max) or Take the Head (reduces D_req by 20% to 30%, lowering 2.0M to 1.4M).

solverPipeline.name: Quick Summon Triage (Priority 1: Zero Action Cost)
solverPipeline.logic: Check if Beelzebub (4★) is callable with Trance Lv >= 2. If callable, trigger Beelzebub call -> deals 3,000,000 plain damage immediately. Solves up to 3M requirement with 1 button.

solverPipeline.name: Character Plain Nuke Triage (Priority 2: On-Demand Skills)
solverPipeline.logic: Check availability of character skills: Threo Ground Zero (up to 2.04M), Lunalu Facsimile (duplicate Ground Zero for +2.04M), Clarisse Atomic Resolution (710k + Dispel), Catura Moo-Licious (800k). Dispatch in order of highest damage yield until sum >= D_req.

solverPipeline.name: Charge Attack Alignment (Priority 3: Ougi Phase)
solverPipeline.logic: If plain damage can be delivered via Charge Attack (e.g. Water Yodarha 3 stacks = 999,999 plain; Gwynne high HP = 1,200,000 plain): toggle Charge Attack ON and ensure sufficient charge bar before normal attack phase.

solverPipeline.name: Guard Fallback Evaluation (Priority 4: Survival Mitigation)
solverPipeline.logic: If sum of available plain damage is strictly less than D_req: DO NOT waste cooldowns. Immediately dispatch .btn-guard-all. In Battle System 2.0, Guard reduces incoming Plain damage by 90% (e.g. 70% Max HP becomes 7% Max HP, 99,999 Plain becomes 9,999 Plain), preserving the party for subsequent turns.

raidOmenMappings.optimalSolver: Beelzebub call (3M plain) OR Threo Ground Zero (2.04M plain) OR Clarisse + nuke
raidOmenMappings.failurePenalty: Lucilius gains Dark Elemental damage penetration on all subsequent attacks.

raidOmenMappings.mitigationStrategy: All allies take 77,777 Plain damage. Survive by having > 77,777 HP, calling Titan summon (1 HP survival guts), or Guarding (.btn-guard-all reduces plain damage to ~7,777).
Uncancelable 999,999 Plain damage inflicting permanent Death Ineluctable. Bypass with 10% execution nuke or sacrifice frontline character with Guts/Tenacity.
